spans.s:
यूथ n. (-थं) A multitude of birds or beasts, a herd, a flock.
 f. (-थी) A
kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.)
 E. यु to mix, थक् Unādi
aff., and the vowel made long.

यूथनाथ m. (-थः) A large elephant, the leader of a wild herd.
 E. यूथ a
multitude, (of elephants,) and नाथ lord.

यूथप m. (-पः) The leader of a wild herd of elephants.
 E. यूथ a herd,
and प who protects: see the last.

यूथभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) An elephant turned out or driven from a herd.
 E. यूथ a herd, भ्रष्ट expelled.

यूथशस् Adv. Gregariously, in flocks.
 E. यूथ and शसि aff.

यूथिका f. (-का)
 1. A sort of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.)
 2. Globe
amaranth.
 E. यूथी the jasmine, कन् aff., fem. form.
